stats.fact: Google AI Studio's Antigravity agent was integrated into Build mode in March 2026, originally launched as a standalone VS Code-based IDE in November 2025 after the Windsurf team acquisition for $2.4 billion
At Google I/O 2026 (May 2026), Google announced native Android app building in AI Studio, one-click Cloud Run deploy, Google Workspace integration, and Gemini 3.5 Flash as default model
Antigravity 2.0 was claimed to have created an operating system in 12 hours at Google I/O 2026, showcasing autonomous multi-agent parallel development
Google AI Studio is free to use — no subscription, no credits, no credit card required for the interface; billing only begins when exceeding free Gemini Developer API quota
First two app deployments to Google Cloud (Cloud Run) are free with no credit card required, per I/O 2026 announcement
The AI Studio Build mode supports full-stack web apps with Firestore (NoSQL), Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), Firebase Authentication, and Cloud Run hosting — all provisioned automatically by the agent
